job.name: ig13_b1
job.meaning: человек громко смеётся в компании, остальные смотрят на него с неловкостью
job.prompt: A man in his thirties laughing loudly and awkwardly at a dinner table while three friends around him look at him with polite uncomfortable faces, restaurant interior.
job.style: Photorealistic cinematic still, moody dramatic film look, muted desaturated palette with warm amber highlights, soft directional light, shallow depth of field, gentle film grain, looks like a frame from a premium psychological drama. Wide horizontal-feeling composition that will be cropped to the lower half of a vertical video. Absolutely NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO logos, NO watermarks anywhere.
job.style_qa: фотореалистичный кинематографичный кадр в приглушённой драматичной гамме, смысл соответствует описанию, без надписей, букв и логотипов, без искажённых рук и лиц
